integrity: Entire graph, face rules, Morse matching algorithm, automorphism generators, and independent chain computations are supplied in a standalone executable verifier.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite twelve-vertex graph case only; no infinite-family or equivariant homotopy classification. Primary higher-independence paper has different general graph hypotheses; unindexed equivalent calculations remain possible.
title: The Chvátal two-independence complex is a three-sphere with a reversed reflection character
